entry.title: Cross-Environment Lateral Movement and Exfiltration
entry.summary: An adversary is moving laterally between internal hosts that do not typically interact and is exfiltrating data via high-volume network flows or anomalous DNS patterns.

entry.title: Cross-Environment Pivot: From Web Exploit to Control Plane
entry.summary: An adversary has exploited a public-facing application to obtain credentials or session tokens, then pivoted to Cloud and SaaS administrative planes to establish persistence.

entry.title: Hidden Network Connection Discrepancy
entry.summary: An adversary is using an eBPF rootkit to hide C2 connections from user-space reporting (Netlink), creating a detectable discrepancy between historical network flow logs and point-in-time socket snapshots.

entry.title: AD Rights Management Service Reconnaissance
entry.summary: An adversary is mapping the Active Directory Rights Management Services (AD RMS) deployment by enumerating its SOAP endpoints and identifying rights-policy templates from an unprivileged domain account.

entry.title: MacSync RAT Persistence and Wallet Tampering
entry.summary: An adversary has established long-term persistence on a macOS host using a Mach-O RAT and LaunchAgents, potentially while tampering with cryptocurrency wallet applications or using signed capture helpers.

entry.title: MacSync Stealer In-Memory Lure and Credential Access
entry.summary: An adversary is using malvertising lures directing users to a legitimate AI domain to execute a polymorphic zsh loader that delivers an in-memory AppleScript for credential theft.

entry.title: Endpoint Persistence and Data Exfiltration
entry.summary: An intruder has staged stolen credentials in local temporary directories or established persistence via macOS LaunchDaemons and Windows UpdateCache directories following a malicious document lure.

entry.title: Cross-Platform Malicious Document and Script Delivery
entry.summary: An adversary is using social engineering to drive users toward a malicious Google Doc sidebar that executes platform-specific scripts (macOS ClickFix or Windows ClickOnce/PowerShell loaders) from campaign infrastructure.

entry.title: Kimwolf v7 ENS Resolution and Outbound DDoS
entry.summary: An intruder is using Ethereum ENS domains for resilient C2 resolution and coordinating outbound DDoS attacks from IoT or Android-based assets.

entry.title: Kimwolf v7: Masquerading and ADB Propagation
entry.summary: An adversary is using unauthenticated ADB access on port 5555 to install Kimwolf malware, which then masquerades as the 'netd_service' system process.

entry.title: Tailored Payload Persistence and NTLM Relay
entry.summary: An adversary is establishing persistence using tailored executables in the Temp directory and initiating a Python-based NTLM relay attack to achieve domain-level takeover.

entry.title: Spring Ring: PowerShell RAT Delivery and Defensive Evasion
entry.summary: An attacker is using vishing to deliver a PowerShell RAT and is bypassing AMSI in-memory via the amsiInitFailed flag to evade detection, followed by beaconing to the campaign's C2 domain.

entry.title: Spring Ring: Teams Support Impersonation and Initial Discovery
entry.summary: An adversary is impersonating internal IT support via external Microsoft Teams accounts to trick users into running remote support tools and conducting initial environment reconnaissance.

entry.title: Impersonation-led Remote Support and Lateral Movement
entry.summary: An adversary has used social engineering to gain access via Remote Monitoring and Management (RMM) software, followed by staging a portable Node.js runtime for C2 and attempting internal discovery and WinRM lateral movement.

entry.title: Automated Attack Infrastructure and Discovery
entry.summary: An adversary is using legitimate automation platforms and external scanning tools to conduct phishing operations and manage C2 workflows through automated webhooks.

entry.title: Identity Hijacking and Session Maintenance from Adversary VPS
entry.summary: An adversary is maintaining persistent access to a large volume of compromised identities using automated workflows (Make.com, Telegram) originating from VPS infrastructure like Virtuo, visible as high-density account access from single external IPs.

entry.title: SharePoint Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution
entry.summary: An attacker is chaining an authentication bypass with a .NET gadget chain to execute shell commands on a SharePoint server via the Business Connectivity Services endpoint.

entry.title: Shai-Hulud: Cloud Discovery and Encrypted Exfiltration
entry.summary: An adversary is using a compromised development environment to enumerate cloud and vault secrets, followed by exfiltration via a mimicry domain or GitHub dead-drop fallback.

entry.title: Shai-Hulud: Developer Hook Poisoning and Memory Harvesting
entry.summary: An adversary is using poisoned IDE hooks (VSCode/Claude Code) to execute a modular Bun-based framework that establishes deadman-switch persistence and extracts secrets from GitHub runner memory.

entry.title: Industrial-Scale AI Model Distillation
entry.summary: China-based AI companies are using fraudulent account clusters and 'transfer station' proxies to conduct high-volume extraction of proprietary model capabilities through API gateways.

entry.title: Cloud Identity Multi-hop C2 and Web Exploitation
entry.summary: An adversary has exploited a public-facing application and established a command-and-control channel through multi-hop proxies or Tor to obfuscate their post-exploitation discovery activity.

entry.title: OysterLoader Multi-Stage Evasive Infection
entry.summary: An adversary is using trojanized MSI installers (impersonating tools like PuTTY or WinSCP) to execute a multi-stage loader that performs API hammering and custom LZMA decompression in-memory before checking in to a C2 server.

entry.title: Sensitive Document Staging and Exfiltration
entry.summary: An intruder has identified sensitive legal or financial documents via iManage or similar repositories and is staging them in user-writable profile paths for exfiltration via portable transfer tools or web-based uploads.

entry.title: UNC3753 Vishing to VDI Bridge
entry.summary: An intruder has gained initial access via vishing, establishing a beachhead with an unauthorized RMM tool (like SuperOps or AnyDesk) on a host that then pivots into corporate VDI environments.

entry.title: Developer Asset Stealer and Exfiltration
entry.summary: An intruder has deployed a cross-platform RAT within developer workspaces, disguised as a Google update service, which is now exfiltrating credentials and wallets while performing anti-forensic cleanup.

entry.title: UNK_DeadDrop IDE Phishing and Task Automation
entry.summary: An adversary has lured a developer to clone a malicious GitHub repository, triggering automated IDE task execution and a persistent VSIX extension installation.

entry.title: Third-party SaaS Data Exfiltration via OAuth (Klue)
entry.summary: An adversary is leveraging a compromised third-party OAuth application (Klue Battlecards) to exfiltrate CRM data from Salesforce via automated API calls from known actor infrastructure.

entry.title: VoidLink Lateral Scanning and Mesh-Network C2
entry.summary: Adversaries are using compromised Linux servers to host SOCKS gateways and mesh peer-to-peer C2 nodes, enabling internal reconnaissance and stealthy exfiltration.

entry.title: VoidLink Initial Access and Rootkit Persistence
entry.summary: An adversary is leveraging vulnerable Apache Dubbo instances or stolen credentials to deploy a modular ZigLang-based implant that evades detection via fileless execution and user-space SO/DLL hijacking.

entry.title: Network Infrastructure Persistence and Exfiltration
entry.summary: A state-sponsored actor has compromised legacy network devices to exfiltrate configuration data via TFTP and maintain persistence through unauthorized management access.

entry.title: Cisco Edge Exposure and Smart Install Exploitation
entry.summary: Adversaries are identifying exposed Cisco network devices and exploiting the Smart Install feature (CVE-2018-0171) or abusing weak SNMP community strings for initial access and configuration theft.

entry.title: Malicious Flutter Package Build Execution
entry.summary: An attacker has compromised a Flutter package maintainer to inject build-time RCE, resulting in developer or CI machines downloading malicious dependencies and beaconing to C2 during the build process.

entry.title: PaperCut Pre-Auth RCE and System Discovery
entry.summary: An unauthenticated attacker is exploiting a logic flaw in PaperCut NG/MF to load malicious Java classes, resulting in system profiling commands being spawned from the application server process.

entry.title: Direct-to-IP C2 and DNS-Bypass Activity
entry.summary: Adversaries are bypassing DNS-based security controls by using hard-coded IP addresses for command-and-control and staged payload delivery.

entry.title: Automated Identity and Pipeline Hijacking
entry.summary: An adversary is using autonomous AI agents to perform rapid credential harvesting from secrets managers and exfiltrating cloud keys via CI/CD pipeline abuse.

entry.title: Interlock RAT Network Tunneling and RDP Movement
entry.summary: An attacker is using Cloudflare Tunnels (trycloudflare.com) to mask command-and-control traffic and leveraging RDP for lateral movement from the initial beachhead.

entry.title: Akira Ransomware: Data Exfiltration and Impact
entry.summary: An adversary has staged reconnaissance data in ProgramData, exfiltrated it via FileZilla/SFTP, and deployed Akira ransomware binaries (locker.exe/win.exe) for environment-wide encryption.

entry.title: Bumblebee discovery and domain credential harvesting
entry.summary: An intruder has pivoted from an initial workstation to domain discovery using built-in utilities, creating high-privilege service-style accounts, and staging NTDS.dit or LSASS dumps for credential harvesting.

entry.title: Bumblebee Initial Access and C2 Deployment
entry.summary: An attacker has compromised an IT administrator via SEO poisoning, leading to the execution of a trojanized installer that side-loads Bumblebee and establishes AdaptixC2 connectivity.

entry.title: Volume Shadow Copy Manipulation and Impact
entry.summary: An adversary is abusing the Volume Shadow Copy Service (VSS) to either extract the Active Directory database (ntds.dit) for credential theft or delete recovery points to prevent rollback before encrypting data.

entry.title: VSS Abuse Precursors: Exploitation and Lateral Movement
entry.summary: An attacker is moving laterally from a compromised internet-facing asset to locate high-value targets for VSS-based credential theft or ransomware deployment.

entry.title: Automated Cloud Tenant Enumeration
entry.summary: An intruder is using automated Node.js or Graph-based scripts to rapidly discover internal applications and collect sensitive files from a compromised cloud identity following a passkey-themed social engineering attack.

entry.title: Passkey Phishing and Identity Hijack
entry.summary: An adversary is using lookalike domains to lure users into AiTM phishing or device-code flows, subsequently hijacking sessions and registering unauthorized MFA methods for persistence.

entry.title: Rails Active Storage Arbitrary File Read and RCE
entry.summary: An intruder is exploiting CVE-2026-66066 by uploading crafted MAT/HDF5 files via the Rails direct-upload endpoint to trigger a libvips file-read oracle, potentially escalating to RCE via signed variation forgery.

entry.title: Linux Kernel Copy-Fail Crypto Exploitation
entry.summary: An unprivileged local attacker is corrupting the kernel page cache by splicing sensitive binaries into AF_ALG crypto sockets to escalate privileges to root.

entry.title: TeamPCP: ECS Execution and Container Discovery
entry.summary: An adversary is leveraging stolen cloud credentials to gain interactive container access via the AWS SSM Agent (ECS Exec) to perform discovery and exfiltrate secrets.

entry.title: Anomalous Cloud Identity and API Abuse (TeamPCP)
entry.summary: An adversary is leveraging credentials stolen through DevOps supply-chain injections to perform rapid automated secret validation and cloud discovery from known VPN/VPS hosting nodes.

entry.title: VerdantBamboo Proxied Cloud Identity Access
entry.summary: An adversary is using a compromised internal appliance as a proxy to authenticate to M365, appearing to originate from a trusted corporate egress IP to bypass security controls.

entry.title: VerdantBamboo Edge Appliance Backdoor and Pivot
entry.summary: An intruder has compromised an edge appliance (Egnyte, Synology, or pfSense) using stolen credentials, escalated privileges via a sudo misconfiguration, and deployed the BRICKSTORM backdoor using DoH for command-and-control.

entry.title: Node.js Backdoor and Internal Pivot
entry.summary: An intruder is maintaining command-and-control via a portable Node.js runtime hidden in a user profile and is performing internal discovery or lateral movement via WinRM.
